content.text: why do you want to remove mixinTypes and primaryType from RDF?
why do you want to remove mixinTypes and primaryType from RDF?
>> because they are meaningless in the context of RDF. They are JCR concepts
>> only in the fcrepo-module-auth-rbacl and fcrepo-module-auth-xacml modules... which are rarely used.
It doesn't look like "meaningless" to me.....  Did you receive complains from users? Just curious about it.

It's not meaningless in the sense that it has literally no meaning. It's meaningless in the sense that it conveys information that is not useful and in fact could be harmful, by confusing people and preventing from using the correct means of establishing types:

This task is to remove the following RDF elements from the default resource view.
Note, these elements show up prominently in the HTML UI; therefore, in the process of working this ticket it should be verified that the HTML UI is also cleaned up as necessary for a clean view.

  • remove UUID from resource HTML view
  • remove mixinTypes
  • remove primaryType
  • remove hasAccessRoles
